title: Portable Dehumidifiers
agency: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE ARMY.AMC.ACC.MISSION INSTALLATION CONTRACTING COMMAND.419TH CSB.W6QM MICC-FT DRUM
description_text: Salient Characteristics: 22-pint, ENERGY STAR-certified portable dehumidifier with coverage for up to 1,500 square feet. Unit must include an adjustable humidistat and a ?comfort? mode that automatically regulates humidity based on room temperature. The unit shall include soft-touch electronic controls, a water-level window, bucket-full indicator, and capability for continuous drainage using an included hose. Unit must operate down to 41�F, include an ultra-quiet two-speed fan, and use environmentally friendly R32 refrigerant. Delivery Requirement: All items must be delivered no later than 14 days after award.
